name: Music Tutor
summary: Music Tutor helps you learn to read music through note-identification practice. Choose your practice clefs and note ranges, answer the notes shown on the staff, and review your session results and statistics. Treble and bass reference screens help connect staff positions with note names. The familiar circular home buttons and a resizable 2D layout keep practice easy to navigate. One purchase includes the Horizon edition's features without advertising or in-app purchases.
